paragraphs: I'm applying for the Strategic Finance Analyst role at 1stDibs. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I'm interested because the role sits with leaders across Supply, Product, Operations and Marketing, and a marketplace for design and luxury goods has a lot of moving parts to model.

At Lenovo I spent two years as a Senior Business Analyst, building forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15% and running variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation. At JPMorgan Asset Management I worked as a consultant on marketing-channel budget allocation, benchmarked past allocations to find 30% in efficiency gains, and prepared executive-level briefs for senior leadership.

That maps to the KPI models, budgets, rolling forecasts and monthly reporting decks on your team. My marketing budget work should help with the Marketing partnership in particular. I'd welcome the chance to talk.

outreach: Hi [Name], I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and I'm applying for the Strategic Finance Analyst role at 1stDibs. At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario analyses that improved capital efficiency by 15%, and at JPMorgan Asset Management I worked on marketing-channel budget allocation. I'd love to hear how finance partners with the business teams. Would you have 15 minutes for a quick chat?
